name: Renault 12 Gordini
description: The Renault 12 Gordini was introduced in 1971 as the sporting variant of Renault's popular family sedan. Featuring a tuned 1.6L inline-four engine producing 96 bhp at 6200 rpm and 125 Nm of torque at 4500 rpm, the Gordini version delivered spirited front-wheel-drive performance with a top speed of 175 km/h. Distinguished by its distinctive blue paint with white stripes, the Gordini badge represented Renault's racing heritage and offered enthusiasts an affordable yet capable performance car of the early 1970s.
